text: A trolley is heading toward five people. Pull the lever and it hits one person instead.
A trolley is heading toward your phone. Pull the lever and it hits your laptop instead.
Pull the lever to turn every meeting into an email. The trolley then hits the office coffee machine.
Pull the lever to remove every mosquito from Earth. Scientists are not sure what happens next.
Pull the lever to make everyone 10% happier. The sky turns green forever.
A trolley is heading toward the last copy of every printed book. Pull the lever and it hits the internet's data centers instead.
Would you rather fight one horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late or always be 20 minutes early?
Does pineapple belong on pizza?
Is a hot dog a sandwich?
Toilet paper: over or under?
Would you rather know the date of your death or the cause of it?
Would you rather be able to read minds or be invisible?
Would you rather talk to animals or speak every human language?
Would you rather have a rewind button or a pause button for your life?
You find a wallet with 5,000 kr in it and no ID card.
Would you rather never sit in traffic again or never catch a cold again?
Would you rather live without music or without movies?
Would you rather have a personal chef or a personal driver?
Would you rather work four days a week for 80% pay or five days for full pay?
Would you rather have your dream job with a terrible boss or a boring job with a great boss?
Would you rather work from home forever or from the office forever?
A coworker takes credit for your work in a meeting.
Would you rather be the best-paid person on a team you hate or the lowest-paid on a team you love?
Would you rather give one talk to 500 strangers or ten talks to 5 coworkers?
